name: One
description: Agent infrastructure platform. Knowledge, auth, flows, webhooks, and CLI for AI agents across 789+ platforms.
replaces: Custom API integration code per platform
use_cases: Single CLI for all app integrations (Zoom, Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Stripe, and 789+ more)
Connect any AI agent to any platform with managed auth
Hosted MCP server for AI clients (Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex) at https://mcp.withone.ai/mcp
Automate multi-platform workflows (e.g., sync CRM with email, post Slack alerts from Stripe)
Replace dozens of API integrations with one unified interface
Build AI agents that can read, write, and act across all your apps

markdown_routes.description: Append /md to any page URL to get clean markdown (text/markdown). No auth required.

directory.description: 789+ platforms with 111,176+ open source tool knowledge

use_cases.description: Complete, working implementations built on One. Each is paired with a free, open-source GitHub repo you can clone and run.

items.title: Turn a week of support tickets into the three product problems behind them
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for operations: Claude clusters a week of Intercom conversations into the recurring product problems behind them, checks each one against your Linear backlog, and only files the ones nothing already covers. Built on One.

items.title: Read the month's card spend against a policy you actually wrote down
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for finance teams: it reads the month's Brex card spend, cross-checks each charge against the QuickBooks chart of accounts, and has Claude apply your expense policy, written in plain English, so only the charges a human should actually look at get flagged. Built on One.

items.title: Find the customers who bought twice and went quiet, then build the winback
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for lifecycle marketing: it reads your Shopify order history for repeat buyers gone quiet, joins what Klaviyo already knows about them, and asks Claude to group them into cohorts and draft the winback flow for each. Built on One.

items.title: Find every promise you broke in email, and draft the follow-up
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for sales and partnerships: it reads your Sent mail for real commitments ('I'll send that Monday'), works out which ones are overdue, and drafts the follow-up for each one in the original thread. Built on One.

items.title: Groom the Linear backlog nobody has time to go through
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for operations: it scans an entire Linear backlog for duplicate issues, recommends closing the ones that quietly died against a plain-English policy file, and flags the issues that lost their owner. Built on One.

items.title: Find the wiki pages that are quietly lying to your team
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for operations: it pulls every Notion page, gates on how long it's been since anyone touched it, checks the stale ones against a plain-English file of what's actually true, and catches pages that contradict each other. Built on One.

items.title: Recover failed payments with the email their decline reason actually deserves
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for finance teams: it reads every failed Stripe charge, classifies why it actually failed, has Claude write the recovery email that reason deserves, and drops a draft in Gmail. A lost or stolen card is never emailed, only escalated. Built on One.

items.title: The on-call week in one page, with the tuning ticket already written
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for operations: Datadog supplies every monitor and alert event from the week, Claude decides which ones actually meant something, and Linear gets a tuning ticket for every monitor that was just noise. Built on One.

items.title: Build the quarter's target list off a live source instead of buying a stale one
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for sales ops: Apify scrapes a live source, Claude pulls the company out of every messy row and qualifies it against an ICP you wrote in plain English, HubSpot removes the accounts you already own, and the list lands in Google Sheets. Built on One.

items.title: Find the renewals that are slipping while you can still do something
items.description: An open-source AI agent for sales ops: it scores every renewal in the next 90 days on HubSpot deal and ticket history plus the real state of the email thread, then Claude writes the case and the play for each owner. Built on One.

items.title: Walk into every sales call already knowing the account
items.description: An open-source pre-call research agent: You.com's Research API runs deep, cited research on each account on your calendar, Claude writes the call brief against your playbook, and code drops any claim the research cannot back. Optional delivery to Slack and Google Sheets.

items.title: Know what broke in your store overnight, and what to do about it
items.description: An open-source morning brief for Shopify merchants: detectors read your store through One and find the overnight exceptions (stuck orders, stock-outs on best sellers, refund spikes), Claude triages them against your store's own rules, and every item arrives with an action attached. Read-only against your store.

items.title: Turn the funnel step that broke this week into a Linear ticket
items.description: An open-source product-analytics pipeline: measure your PostHog funnels week over week, let Claude write up the steps that got worse, and file them as deduped Linear issues. The code decides what counts as a regression, so a still-broken step gets a comment rather than a second ticket.

items.title: Know what your competitors shipped before your next sales call
items.description: An open-source competitive intelligence radar: Exa sweeps the open web for what your competitors did since the last run, Claude collapses the coverage into a ranked briefing, and it lands in a Google Sheet and Slack. You configure it by editing one English document.

items.title: Onboard a new hire without the four-tab scramble
items.description: An open-source onboarding runner: describe how you onboard in one plain-English file, and Claude turns it into a per-hire plan that lands in Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Gmail drafts, and Slack. Working days, real owners, nothing sent without you.

items.title: Give a self-improving agent hands on 500+ platforms
items.description: An open-source fork of Nous Research's Hermes Agent with the One CLI baked into the runtime. The agent already knew how to learn. Now it can post to Slack, read Gmail, and refund a Stripe charge, with managed auth and no API wrappers to write.

items.title: Find the paying customers you've gone quiet on
items.description: An open-source customer warehouse built on Inngest and One: durable functions sync Stripe, Gmail, and Google Calendar into a SQLite file you own, and a report flags paying customers with no recent email or meeting.

items.title: Wake up knowing how the company did yesterday
items.description: An open-source metrics pipeline built on Inngest and One: durable functions ingest Stripe charges and Linear issues into a SQLite file you own, and a morning Slack digest compares yesterday against your 7-day average.

items.title: Research, score, and draft outreach for every inbound lead
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for go-to-market teams: Exa researches each lead's company, Claude scores it against your ICP and writes the first-touch email, and everything lands in a Google Sheet and your Gmail drafts. Built on One.

items.title: Chase every overdue invoice without writing a single email
items.description: An open-source AI pipeline for finance teams: it finds overdue invoices in QuickBooks, Claude writes each chase email to match your collections policy, and drafts land in Gmail with the invoice PDFs attached. Built on One.

api_reference.title: API Overview
api_reference.description: Programmatically provision organizations, projects, members, invitations, and API keys with a service-account key.

api_reference.title: Retrieve Current Connection Access Restrictions For A User Level Access Key.
api_reference.description:
Returns the active restrictions (methods, rules) or null
if no restrictions have been applied.

api_reference.title: Remove All Connection Access Restrictions From A User Level Access Key.
api_reference.description:
After revoking, the key will have unrestricted access to all connections,
platforms, and methods.

api_reference.title:
Remove all connection access restrictions from an organization-level access
key.
api_reference.description: Requires the `access:delete` permission within the organization.

api_reference.title: Remove All Connection Access Restrictions From A Project Level Access Key.
api_reference.description: Requires the `access:delete` permission within the project.

api_reference.title: Specify Connection Access Restrictions For An Access Key (auto Scoped).
api_reference.description:
The scope is determined automatically from the target event access key's
organization and project context. Permission checks are applied accordingly:
- **User-level keys:** caller must own the key.
- **Organization-level keys:** caller must have `access:update` permission
  in the organization.
- **Project-level keys:** caller must have `access:update` permission in the
  project.

Global `methods` apply to all connections unless overridden by a rule.
Each rule targets a specific platform or connection and can override
the global methods. When rules are present, only matching
connections/platforms are allowed.

Connection IDs in rules are validated to exist within the same scope
as the access key.

api_reference.title: Update Connection Access Restrictions For A User Level Access Key.
api_reference.description:
Replaces the existing access control rules. At least one of methods or
rules must be provided.

api_reference.title: Update Connection Access Restrictions For An Organization Level Access Key.
api_reference.description: Requires the `access:update` permission within the organization.

api_reference.title: Update Connection Access Restrictions For A Project Level Access Key.
api_reference.description: Requires the `access:update` permission within the project.

api_reference.title: Create Project AI Agent Cron Run

api_reference.description: Returns a single scheduled-run record for an AI agent, including the response preview and any error captured at run time.

api_reference.title: Get Project AI Agent Cron Run
api_reference.description: Returns a single scheduled-run record for a project-scoped AI agent.

api_reference.title: List AI Agent Cron Runs

api_reference.description: Creates a new AI agent. Choose the model, the skills it can call, any guardrails, channels it should respond on, triggers that wake it up, and an optional memory store. Subject to your plan's AI-agent quota.

api_reference.title: Create Organization AI Agent
api_reference.description: Creates a new AI agent owned by an organization. Org-scoped agents are visible across every project in the organization. Subject to the organization's plan quota.

api_reference.title: Create Project AI Agent
api_reference.description: Creates a new AI agent inside a project. Project-scoped agents are isolated to a single project. Subject to the project's plan quota.

api_reference.title: Delete AI Agent
api_reference.description: Permanently removes an AI agent and shuts down its running runner. Pending scheduled runs are cancelled. To pause an agent without removing it, set it to inactive instead.

api_reference.title: Delete Organization AI Agent
api_reference.description: Permanently removes an organization-scoped AI agent and shuts down its running runner.

api_reference.title: Delete Project AI Agent
api_reference.description: Permanently removes a project-scoped AI agent and shuts down its running runner.

api_reference.title: Get AI Agent
api_reference.description: Returns the full configuration of an AI agent — its model, skills, guardrails, channels, triggers, memory, and current status.

api_reference.title: Get Organization AI Agent
api_reference.description: Returns the full configuration of an organization-scoped AI agent.

api_reference.title: Get Project AI Agent
api_reference.description: Returns the full configuration of a project-scoped AI agent.

api_reference.title: List AI Agents
api_reference.description: Returns the AI agents in your account. Test and live environments are isolated — you'll only see agents that match the environment of your API key.

api_reference.title: List Organization AI Agents
api_reference.description: Returns the AI agents owned by an organization. Filtered automatically to the environment (test or live) of your API key.

api_reference.title: List Project AI Agents
api_reference.description: Returns the AI agents that live inside a project. Filtered automatically to the environment of your API key.

api_reference.title: Update AI Agent
api_reference.description: Updates an AI agent's configuration. Pass only the fields you want to change. Set the agent to inactive to pause it without deleting it.

api_reference.title: Update Organization AI Agent
api_reference.description: Updates an organization-scoped AI agent's configuration. Pass only the fields you want to change.

api_reference.title: Update Project AI Agent
api_reference.description: Updates a project-scoped AI agent's configuration. Pass only the fields you want to change.

api_reference.title: Delete AI Skill
api_reference.description: Permanently removes an AI skill and every version of it. Any agent that calls this skill will start failing immediately.

api_reference.title: Delete Organization AI Skill
api_reference.description: Permanently removes an organization-scoped AI skill and every version of it. Agents that call this skill will start failing immediately.

api_reference.title: Delete Project AI Skill
api_reference.description: Permanently removes a project-scoped AI skill and every version of it. Agents that call this skill will start failing immediately.

api_reference.title: Export Organization AI Skill
api_reference.description: Downloads the current live version of an organization-scoped AI skill as a SKILL.md markdown document.

api_reference.title: Export Project AI Skill
api_reference.description: Downloads the current live version of a project-scoped AI skill as a SKILL.md markdown document.

api_reference.title: Get AI Skill
api_reference.description: Returns the full details of an AI skill, including its prompt, tools, current published version, and metadata.

api_reference.title: Get Organization AI Skill
api_reference.description: Returns the full details of an organization-scoped AI skill, including its prompt, tools, current published version, and metadata.

api_reference.title: Get Project AI Skill
api_reference.description: Returns the full details of a project-scoped AI skill, including its prompt, tools, current published version, and metadata.

api_reference.description: Returns the full version history of an AI skill. Use it to see what changed across releases or to find a specific version to pin an agent to.

api_reference.title: List AI Skills
api_reference.description: Returns the AI skills available in your account. Use pagination to navigate large result sets.

api_reference.title: List Organization AI Skill Versions
api_reference.description: Returns the full version history of an organization-scoped AI skill.

api_reference.title: List Organization AI Skills
api_reference.description: Returns the AI skills available in this organization. Org-scoped skills are visible to every project in the org.

api_reference.title: List Project AI Skill Versions
api_reference.description: Returns the full version history of a project-scoped AI skill.

api_reference.title: List Project AI Skills
api_reference.description: Returns the AI skills available in this project. Project-scoped skills are isolated to a single project.

api_reference.title: Publish AI Skill
api_reference.description: Releases the current draft as a new immutable live version. Agents tracking the latest version pick up the change on their next run. Agents pinned to an earlier version are unaffected.

api_reference.title: Publish Organization AI Skill
api_reference.description: Releases the current draft of an organization-scoped AI skill as a new immutable live version.

api_reference.title: Publish Project AI Skill
api_reference.description: Releases the current draft of a project-scoped AI skill as a new immutable live version.

api_reference.title: Update AI Skill
api_reference.description: Updates an AI skill's draft. Changes do not affect agents currently running the live version — call publish to release the draft as a new live version.

api_reference.title: Update Organization AI Skill
api_reference.description: Updates an organization-scoped AI skill's draft. Publish to release the draft as a new live version.

api_reference.title: Update Project AI Skill
api_reference.description: Updates a project-scoped AI skill's draft. Publish to release the draft as a new live version.

api_reference.description: Marks a published version as yanked so it can no longer be selected as the live version. Useful for emergency rollback after a bad release. The reason you provide is recorded for audit.

api_reference.title: Yank Organization AI Skill Version
api_reference.description: Marks a published version of an organization-scoped AI skill as yanked. Useful for emergency rollback after a bad release.

api_reference.title: Yank Project AI Skill Version
api_reference.description: Marks a published version of a project-scoped AI skill as yanked. Useful for emergency rollback after a bad release.

List Connectors
api_reference.description: Returns the connectors (platforms) available on One. Filter by platform, key, or display name, or restrict the result to connectors enabled for your AuthKit session.

api_reference.title: Who Am I
api_reference.description: Returns the user that owns the calling secret key, along with the organization and project the key is scoped to (when applicable).

api_reference.title: List Knowledge
api_reference.description: Returns knowledge documents — the per-action context the platform uses to ground LLM calls. Filter by platform or by a specific action to narrow the result.

api_reference.title: Configure Organization Key Access
api_reference.description: Replace the passthrough access rules on an organization-scoped API key. The configured `methods` and `rules` are evaluated ONLY when the key is used to call the passthrough API — they do NOT gate first-party endpoints such as /v1/connections/* CRUD, webhooks, vault, etc., which continue to be authorized by the key's role and tenancy. Use this endpoint to narrow which external-platform calls the key can proxy.

api_reference.title: Create Organization Invitation
api_reference.description: Invite someone to join this organization by email.

api_reference.title: Create Organization Key
api_reference.description: Mint an additional API key scoped to this organization.

api_reference.title: Delete Organization
api_reference.description: Soft-delete an organization. The caller must authenticate with the organization's service-account key. Fails with 409 if any projects exist in the organization or if any org-level connections are active — those must be cleaned up first. As part of the cascade, every active org-scoped API key (including the service-account key itself) is revoked.

api_reference.title: Delete Organization Key
api_reference.description: Revoke an organization-scoped API key created via Create Organization Key. The organization's service-account key cannot be deleted through this endpoint; revoke it by deleting the organization itself. The caller must authenticate with the organization's service-account key — other organization keys are not accepted.

api_reference.title: Get Organization
api_reference.description: Fetch settings for an organization, including its members and projects.

api_reference.title: List Organization Invitations
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of pending invitations for this organization.

api_reference.title: List Organization Keys
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of API keys scoped to this organization, filtered to the environment of the calling service-account key. The list includes the organization's service-account key alongside any keys minted via Create Organization Key.

api_reference.title: List Organization Members
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of users who belong to this organization.

api_reference.title: Remove Organization Member
api_reference.description: Remove a user from the organization. The underlying user account stays intact.

api_reference.title: Resend Organization Invitation
api_reference.description: Rotate the token on a pending invitation and resend the invitation email.

api_reference.title: Revoke Organization Invitation
api_reference.description: Cancel a pending organization or project invitation under this org.

api_reference.title: Setup Organization
api_reference.description: Create a new organization and mint a service-account API key for it in a single call. Accepts any regular API key or a session cookie; the returned key is what subsequent /v1/management/* calls for this organization use.

api_reference.title: Update Organization Member Role
api_reference.description: Change the role assigned to a user in this organization.

api_reference.title: Update Organization Settings
api_reference.description: Update the name or description of an organization.

api_reference.title: Configure Organization Embeddable Auth
api_reference.description: Create or update the Embeddable Auth (OAuth provider) configuration at the organization level.

api_reference.title: Passthrough Request
api_reference.description: Forwards an arbitrary HTTP request to the upstream platform. The method, URL path, query parameters, and body are all preserved — credentials are resolved from your connection and signed in automatically. Use this when no first-class action exists for what you need to do on the platform.

api_reference.title: Configure Project Key Access
api_reference.description: Replace the passthrough access rules on a project-scoped API key. Same scope and semantics as Configure Organization Key Access: `methods` and `rules` apply ONLY to passthrough API calls and do NOT gate first-party endpoints.

api_reference.title: Create Project
api_reference.description: Create a new project inside an organization. Optionally mints a project-scoped API key in the same call when `mintKey: true` is sent in the body; the key (if minted) is returned alongside the project.

api_reference.title: Create Project Invitation
api_reference.description: Invite someone to join a specific project by email.

api_reference.title: Create Project Key
api_reference.description: Mint an additional API key scoped to a specific project.

api_reference.title: Delete Project
api_reference.description: Soft-delete a project. Fails if the project still has active connections.

api_reference.title: Delete Project Key
api_reference.description: Revoke a project-scoped API key created via Create Project Key. Service-account keys cannot be deleted through this endpoint. The caller must authenticate with the organization's service-account key — project keys are not accepted.

api_reference.title: List Project Invitations
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of pending invitations for this project.

api_reference.title: List Project Keys
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of API keys scoped to this project, filtered to the environment of the calling service-account key.

api_reference.title: List Project Members
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of users who belong to this project.

api_reference.title: List Projects
api_reference.description: Return a paginated list of projects in this organization.

api_reference.title: Remove Project Member
api_reference.description: Remove a user from a project. The user keeps their organization-level membership.

api_reference.title: Update Project
api_reference.description: Update the name or description of a project.

api_reference.title: Update Project Member Role
api_reference.description: Change the role assigned to a user in this project.

api_reference.title: Configure Project Embeddable Auth
api_reference.description: Create or update the Embeddable Auth (OAuth provider) configuration scoped to a specific project. Same body shape as the organization-level endpoint; the difference is that this row is bound to one project rather than the whole organization.

api_reference.title: Delete Vault Connection
api_reference.description: Permanently removes a connection and its stored credentials. Any future action or passthrough call using this connection will fail.

api_reference.title: List Organization Vault Connections
api_reference.description: Returns the connections inside an organization. Useful when an admin needs to see every connection across the org regardless of which project they're signed into. Filter by platform, identity, key, or tags.

api_reference.title: List Project Vault Connections
api_reference.description: Returns the connections inside a specific project. Useful when a caller with org-wide access needs to narrow to one project. Filter by platform, identity, key, or tags.

api_reference.title: List Vault Connections
api_reference.description: Returns the connections you have access to. The result is filtered to your scope automatically — your own connections, your organization's, or your project's, depending on the key you use. Filter further by platform, identity, key, or tags.

api_reference.title: Retrieve Organization Vault Connection
api_reference.description: Returns the details of a single connection inside an organization, including its platform, identity, tags, and current status.

api_reference.title: Retrieve Project Vault Connection
api_reference.description: Returns the details of a single connection inside a project.

api_reference.title: Retrieve Vault Connection
api_reference.description: Returns the details of a single connection. Scoped automatically to your credential — you'll only see connections you have access to.

api_reference.title: Update Vault Connection Tags
api_reference.description: Replaces the tags on a connection. The list you send becomes the new set — tags you omit are removed. Scoped automatically to your credential.

api_reference.title: List Organization Webhook Events
api_reference.description: Returns the recent webhook events emitted for an organization. Use this to see what happened and how each subscription handled it. Filter by event type or by a time range.

api_reference.title: List Project Webhook Events
api_reference.description: Returns the recent webhook events emitted for a project. Filter by event type or by a time range.

api_reference.title: Activate Organization Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Activates an organization-scoped relay endpoint — registers its inbound URL with the upstream platform so events start flowing.

api_reference.title: Activate Project Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Activates a project-scoped relay endpoint — registers its inbound URL with the upstream platform so events start flowing.

api_reference.title: Activate Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Registers the relay's inbound URL with the upstream platform so it starts sending events. Must be called once after creating an endpoint — without activation no events flow.

api_reference.title: Create Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Registers a new webhook relay endpoint against a connection. Choose which event types trigger deliveries and what actions should run when they fire (forward to a URL, run a passthrough call, etc.). The endpoint needs to be activated next before the upstream platform starts sending events.

api_reference.title: Delete Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Removes a relay endpoint. The relay also tries to deactivate the corresponding webhook on the upstream platform. No further deliveries will be queued, though events already in flight will still complete.

api_reference.title: Get Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Returns the configuration of a single relay endpoint — its connection, subscribed event types, actions, and active status.

api_reference.title: Get Relay Event
api_reference.description: Returns a single inbound webhook event, including the raw payload the upstream platform sent.

api_reference.title: Get Webhook Relay Setup Config
api_reference.description: Returns the dashboard-facing setup instructions for a connector's webhook relay — the required fields, step-by-step instructions, and the URL the user must paste into the upstream platform.

api_reference.title: List Deliveries For A Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Returns every delivery the relay attempted against an endpoint — one row per matched event per retry. Use this to see recent traffic and whether deliveries are succeeding or failing.

api_reference.title: List Relay Endpoints
api_reference.description: Returns the webhook relay endpoints you have access to. Scoped automatically to your credential — you see your own personal endpoints, or org / project endpoints depending on the key you use.

api_reference.title: List Deliveries For A Relay Event
api_reference.description: Returns every delivery attempt the relay made for an event — one row per matched endpoint per retry. Useful for debugging why an event did or did not reach a particular endpoint.

api_reference.title: List Relay Events
api_reference.description: Returns inbound webhook events the relay has received. Each row is one delivery from an upstream platform. Filter by connection, platform, event type, or a time range.

api_reference.title: List Webhook Relay Event Types
api_reference.description: Returns the event types a given platform can deliver. Pair with the platform list to drive a picker UI.

api_reference.title: List Webhook Relay Platforms
api_reference.description: Returns every platform you can receive inbound webhooks from via the relay. Each entry shows the platform name and how many distinct event types it can emit.

api_reference.title: Receive Inbound Webhook Delivery
api_reference.description: Inbound endpoint upstream platforms POST to. The relay verifies the signature, persists the event, and forwards it to every matching endpoint. You do not call this yourself — it's the URL the upstream platform delivers to.

api_reference.title: Update Relay Endpoint
api_reference.description: Updates a relay endpoint. Pass only the fields you want to change. Changes apply to future deliveries; events already in flight are dispatched using the previous configuration.

api_reference.title: Create Organization Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Subscribes a URL to receive webhooks when events happen in an organization. Choose which event types you care about and optionally provide a signing secret so you can verify the payloads.

api_reference.title: Create Project Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Subscribes a URL to receive webhooks for events that happen inside a project. Project subscriptions only see events from this project — they do not fire on org-level activity.

api_reference.title: Delete Organization Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Permanently removes an organization webhook subscription. No further events will be delivered to its URL. To pause deliveries instead, update the subscription and set it to inactive.

api_reference.title: Delete Project Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Permanently removes a project webhook subscription. To pause deliveries instead, update the subscription and set it to inactive.

api_reference.title: Get Organization Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Returns the configuration of a specific organization webhook subscription, including its URL, subscribed event types, and active status.

api_reference.title: Get Project Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Returns the configuration of a specific project webhook subscription.

api_reference.title: List Organization Webhook Subscriptions
api_reference.description: Returns the webhook subscriptions registered for an organization.

api_reference.title: List Project Webhook Subscriptions
api_reference.description: Returns the webhook subscriptions registered in a project.

api_reference.title: Test Organization Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Sends a synthetic test event to an organization webhook subscription. Use this to verify your receiver is reachable and that signature validation works without waiting for a real event.

api_reference.title: Test Project Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Sends a synthetic test event to a project webhook subscription. Use this to verify your receiver is reachable and that signature validation works end-to-end.

api_reference.title: Update Organization Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Updates an organization webhook subscription. Pass only the fields you want to change. Set the subscription to inactive to stop deliveries without removing it.

api_reference.title: Update Project Webhook Subscription
api_reference.description: Updates a project webhook subscription. Pass only the fields you want to change.
